title: Rejected replay traffic mutates replay LRU and evicts unrelated windows
description: Security review: ReplayProtector moves existing senders to MRU or reconstructs/evicts a window before freshness is known. Rejected captured frames can keep their stale window hot or resurrect an evicted floor and evict another peer, degrading legitimate out-of-order traffic. Perform lookup/check without LRU/admission mutation; only accepted fresh commit may touch/admit/evict after capacity preflight. Add invariant and eviction-victim regressions.
